shortcuts.name: AirDrop to PC
shortcuts.description: Share any photo, video, PDF, or file from the native iOS Share Sheet straight into Downloads\GoonDrop on Windows.

shortcuts.name: Scan Document to PC
shortcuts.description: Scan a document with your iPhone camera and the pages land on your PC as images instantly.

shortcuts.name: Photo to PC
shortcuts.description: Take a photo and beam it straight to your Windows PC. Great for handing homework, receipts, or whiteboards.

shortcuts.name: Voice Memo to PC
shortcuts.description: Record a voice memo from Siri or a shortcut button and it saves straight onto your PC as audio.

shortcuts.name: Send Clipboard to PC
shortcuts.description: Instantly push your iPhone clipboard to the real Windows clipboard. Pair with Back Tap for a 0-second sync.

shortcuts.name: Paste from PC
shortcuts.description: Grab whatever is currently on the Windows clipboard and copy it into your iPhone clipboard.

shortcuts.name: Universal Clipboard
shortcuts.description: FULLY AUTOMATIC two-way clipboard sync in ONE shortcut. It pushes your iPhone clipboard to the PC, and if the PC has something newer it pulls that back instead. Wire this to a repeating Personal Automation and your clipboard converges forever — with or without the app open.

shortcuts.name: Quick Note to PC
shortcuts.description: Send a quick text note, to-do, or idea to your PC. Saved to Desktop\GoonDrop_Backup and shown in the app.

shortcuts.name: Pull Latest Note
shortcuts.description: Fetch your most recent PC note and copy it into your iPhone clipboard.

shortcuts.name: Handoff to PC
shortcuts.description: Instantly open the current Safari page (or any URL) in your Windows default browser.

shortcuts.name: Search the Web on PC
shortcuts.description: Ask Siri or type a query and it opens the search results in your Windows browser.

shortcuts.name: Lock PC
shortcuts.description: One tap locks your Windows PC from anywhere in the house.

shortcuts.name: Sleep PC
shortcuts.description: Put your Windows machine to sleep instantly.

shortcuts.name: Restart PC
shortcuts.description: Restart your Windows PC. Great for after Windows updates or a frozen GPU.

shortcuts.name: Shutdown PC
shortcuts.description: Full shutdown of your Windows PC.

shortcuts.name: Type on PC
shortcuts.description: Send text and it gets TYPED on your Windows PC as if you were at the keyboard. Dictate, then send!

shortcuts.name: PC Says It (Text-to-Speech)
shortcuts.description: Your PC speaks whatever text you send, out loud, through its speakers.

shortcuts.name: Open App on PC
shortcuts.description: Launch an app on Windows by name: spotify, notepad, calculator, chrome, youtube, netflix, cmd, explorer…

shortcuts.name: Find My PC
shortcuts.description: Lost your laptop in the house? Your Windows PC beeps loudly and shouts "I'm right here!" through its speakers.

shortcuts.name: Send Battery to PC
shortcuts.description: Send your iPhone battery %. Perfect for an Automation: "When Battery Level drops below 20%, run this".

shortcuts.name: Send Location to PC
shortcuts.description: Send your GPS location to your PC. Open it in Maps with one tap, or check where you dropped your phone.

shortcuts.name: Find My Phone
shortcuts.description: Push an alert to the Goon Drop app on your phone so it rings/vibrates even if you lost it in the couch.
